excluded_runs.invalid_wrong_entrypoint: Wrong controller selected, not requested trial

limitations: Only layout_a and one run per profile.
No same-condition V1 performance comparison in this validation.
Sampled nominal planar body clearance is not a contact-sensor or continuous collision proof.
STEP11 plus motion confirms lane-controller handoff, not full-course lane-boundary compliance.
Observer was corrected for shutdown reason/controller log filtering after normal trial; controller source hashes stayed unchanged.
